gaps.old_draft_snippet: The geometric details of coating processes also matter substantially: coating geometry and directional deposition angles significantly influence film thickness uniformity and interfacial stress in thin films, which directly impacts the phase profile fidelity achievable in practical diffractive optical elements [[claim:S03-P008]].
gaps.scientific_content: Specific mechanism linking coating geometry and directional deposition angles to film thickness uniformity and interfacial stress, and how these factors impact phase profile fidelity.

gaps.old_draft_snippet: Cascade diffractive architectures address some of these limitations by circumventing the need for explicit nonlinear electronic activation functions, relying instead on optical modulation and free-space propagation to achieve computational depth [[claim:S03-P097]].
gaps.scientific_content: Explanation that cascade diffractive architectures circumvent the need for explicit nonlinear electronic activation functions by relying on optical modulation and free-space propagation.
